functions.description: Parse base Vsansystem log structure: timestamp, host, pid, severity, component, message
Extract IPv4 address (and optional port) from message text
Extract IPv6 address from message text when present
Normalize severity to lowercase standard values and derive coarse action classification from message content

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: dest_ip || dst_ip || destination__ip || server__ip || dstaddr || dstip

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time)).getTime()) / 1000 : _time

functions.description: Set _time from the parsed timestamp (log_time), if one was captured
